required
The ID of the Agent. Example: "225494730938493804".
optional
If true, only total number of items will be returned, without any of
the actual objects.
optional
Cursor position returned by the last request. Use to iterate over
more than 1000 items. Example:
"YWdlbnRfaWQ6NTgwMjkzODE=".
optional
Limit number of returned items (1-1000). Example: "10".
optional
Skip first number of items (0-1000). To iterate over more than 1000
items,  use "cursor". Example: "150".
optional
If true, total number of items will not be calculated, which speeds up
execution time.
optional
The column to sort the results by. Example: "id".
optional
Sort direction. Example: "asc".
